## Pull request overview

Addresses CI build/lint/deploy failures by fixing TypeScript config inheritance issues in new plugin packages, tightening TS build scope in `@object-ui/react`, and resolving a React Compiler lint violation in `plugin-view` tests.

**Changes:**
- Remove per-package `baseUrl`/`paths` overrides (and redundant tsc-only options) from Vite-built plugin packages to restore root `@object-ui/*` path resolution.
- Exclude `*.test.*` files from `@object-ui/react`’s `tsc` build inputs.
- Add explicit TypeScript annotations to eliminate `TS7006` implicit-`any` errors and update a test mock to use React Context for React Compiler purity.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 13 out of 13 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/react/tsconfig.json | Excludes test files from `tsc` build scope to prevent build-time type issues from tests. |
| packages/plugin-workflow/tsconfig.json | Removes `baseUrl`/`paths` override and tsc-only emit options to avoid clobbering root workspace path mappings. |
| packages/plugin-workflow/src/WorkflowDesigner.tsx | Adds explicit event/callback parameter typings to fix implicit-`any` errors. |
| packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/FilterUI.test.tsx | Fixes React Compiler lint violation by replacing outer-scope mutation with Context in mocks (async mock factory). |
| packages/plugin-report/tsconfig.json | Same tsconfig cleanup as other new plugin packages to restore root path mappings. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/ReportViewer.tsx | Adds explicit typings for map/filter/reduce callbacks to address implicit-`any` errors. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/ReportExportEngine.ts | Adds explicit typings for callback params in export helpers to address implicit-`any` errors. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/ReportBuilder.tsx | Adds explicit typings for callback params (and imports) to address implicit-`any` errors. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/LiveReportExporter.ts | Adds explicit typings for map callback params to address implicit-`any` errors. |
| packages/plugin-designer/tsconfig.json | Removes `baseUrl`/`paths` override and tsc-only emit options to avoid clobbering root workspace path mappings. |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/ReportDesigner.tsx | Adds explicit typings in callback params to address implicit-`any` errors. |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/PageDesigner.tsx | Adds explicit typing for palette item mapping to address implicit-`any` errors. |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/DataModelDesigner.tsx | Adds explicit typing for field mapping to address implicit-`any` errors. |
</details>
